column1: # Per-fixture verdict of acadrust against the recorded ACadSharp dump.
# MATCH        every geometry record agreed, to 1e-6
# DIFF:n       same record count, n records disagreed
# COUNT:a/b    acadrust produced a records, ACadSharp b
# OPEN_FAILED  acadrust refused or failed to read the file
# UNCOMPARED   the fixture needs flattening this harness does not do
